about: Harness routes of the roadmap model (generated by scripts/roadmap_model/harness.py through build.py; checked by scripts/check_roadmap.py). Frame base_footprint, bp000; moving sections at L1000. Units m.

harnesses.name: Rear power harness
harnesses.route: rear bay: battery terminals, F0, disconnect, PWR-017, K1/K2, FB-A, charge path; on the rear power plate and the tray-pocket walls

harnesses.name: Drive-section harness
harnesses.route: inside the centre-frame arch: motor driver, hub-motor leads and brakes, CAN1, IMU SPI; on the arch walls and the electronics bracket

harnesses.name: Left side trunk
harnesses.route: front bay to the rear bay along the left side: floor lane beside the front tier, over-wheel guard L, lane between the left tray and the side panel

harnesses.name: Right side trunk
harnesses.route: front bay to the rear bay along the right side: floor lane beside the front tier, over-wheel guard R, lane between the right tray and the side panel

harnesses.name: Front sensor harness
harnesses.route: front panel lane behind the front sensors (E-stop, RESET, MB7060 front, TF-Luna front, RPLIDAR, Gemini), into the front tier at the side

harnesses.name: Front-tier harness
harnesses.route: inside the front tier (lower plate, shelf, DIN carrier); goes out with the tier

harnesses.name: Lift column harness
harnesses.route: deck exit, DP-LIFT, rear and -y faces of the static column: lift motor, lift node CAN3, lift stop sensors

harnesses.name: Upper-body harness
harnesses.route: deck exit, DP-LIFT, fixed sleeve on the -y face of the static column, energy chain behind the column, moving trunk under the adapter plate, risers at the arm post: arms (power, CAN-FD, wrist cameras), ZED Mini, Getac USB-PD, head light, second E-stop

withdrawal.why: battery tray lifts out upward (cover off)
battery tray lifts out upward (cover off)
front-bay tiers (lower plate, shelf, DIN carrier) lift out upward (cover off); the shelf notch around the LiDAR spacer is outside it
cover lifts off; only the deck exit behind the lift base plate passes it

keep_out.why: drive wheel and its side zone up to the wheel guard
drive wheel and its side zone up to the wheel guard
RPLIDAR S3 scan plane +-5 mm (and 5 mm margin) in the open sector
receiver 20 mm metal-free margin (only the receiver's own cables and the rear TF-Luna lead enter it)

exception_zones.why: battery and power module: short direct links between the trays, BMS, fuses, contactors and distribution blocks follow the E-01 schematic and may pass over the top inside this module; insulated, supported, clear of the service parts; the trays come out after unplugging PWR-018 and the tray leads (DP-TRAY-L, DP-TRAY-R)

zones.name: battery and power module (rear)
zones.service: cover off: trays lift out after PWR-018 and the tray leads; FB-A and FB-B fuses from above; BMS through the right side panel; QS1 key and SB50 from outside

zones.name: drive section (wheels, motor driver, centre bracket)
zones.service: motor driver from above after the lift base plate and the channels' rear lids; wheels from below (keep-outs up to the wheel guards)

zones.name: front bay centre (two tiers, DIN carrier)
zones.service: cover off: shelf lifts off its standoffs, then the lower plate (DP-FT connectors)

zones.name: front bay left side zone (power: FB-C, USB-PD, 3.3 V)
zones.service: cover off: parts on the left side plate, fuses up; stays when the tiers lift out

zones.name: front bay right side zone (signal: USB hub, USB-CAN-FD, LiDAR UART)
zones.service: cover off: parts on the right side plate; feed-throughs in the right side panel

zones.name: lift column (static)
zones.service: DP-LIFT disconnects every lift cable; sleeve P-clips on the -y T-slot; flag rod guide on the +y face at the head

zones.name: moving upper body (adapter plate, arm post, arms, head)
zones.service: upper devices unplug at their own connectors; arms at the arm base connectors

corridors.name: left side corridor: floor and side-panel lane beside the front side zone, over-wheel guard L, gap between the left tray and the side wall
right side corridor: floor and side-panel lane beside the front side zone, over-wheel guard R (the rear part beside the right tray is the BMS slot)
central power channel over the drive section, left (SAFE, BAT, motor driver power)
central signal channel over the drive section, right (CAN, USB, sensor lines; deck exit to DP-LIFT)
front panel lane behind the front sensors
rear module exits over the F0 holder into the arch opening (|y| < 0.090)

passages.id: CH-C1 central power channel over the drive section
CH-C2 central signal channel over the drive section
fan lead strip on the arch front wall (fan bracket)
CH-B1 power branch to the left side corridor (over the wheel, through the arch side wall)
CH-B2 signal branch to the right side corridor (over the wheel, through the arch side wall)
C-RM rear module exit channel over the F0 access band into the arch opening
passages.why: exit lane from the rear module into the arch opening (|y| < 90 mm); above the 60 mm F0 access band; cables in a lidded U-channel (harness_cad_changes.csv)
